predecessors.note: The Federation was established on 1 February 1948 as a 'protected state of the United Kingdom (1948-1957)': 'Foreign policy and defence continued to be administered by the British government'; 'Malaya became fully sovereign on 31 August 1957'. Cliopatria draws the land inside its British Colonial Empire row to 1957 (its Federation shape starts in 1958), so the British row is the paramount power of 1948-1957 (vassal_start/vassal_end below) and the predecessor of the sovereign state. Fix fx-49 (2 Nov 2026): the dossier used to start at the independence of 31 August 1957.

Fix fx-49 (2 Nov 2026, request R142): the dossier used to found the state on the independence of 31 August 1957 (a found event on a Kuala Lumpur disc plus a gain of the eleven states from british-colonial-empire); the land is now the state's from 1948, as the p1940-p1949 patch's british-colonial-empire gain of February 1948 (events/12) already draws it as British land until then.

ledger.note: 1 February 1948: the Federation is a 'protected state of the United Kingdom (1948-1957)' (infobox); 'Foreign policy and defence continued to be administered by the British government' and the government was 'headed by a British high commissioner with executive powers'. Recorded here by the protected state, the larger British Colonial Empire being the paramount power (the compiler reads a vassal_start the vassal records over its own land as the counterpart's suzerainty); the british-colonial-empire dossier does not mirror it.

ledger.note: 31 August 1957: the protection ends. 'Malaya became fully sovereign on 31 August 1957' (infobox 'Independence: 31 August 1957'); Singapore, Sarawak and North Borneo stay British. Replaces the old 1957 gain of the eleven states from british-colonial-empire (fx-49), the land being the Federation's since 1948.

1963: the Federation is reconstituted as Malaysia (16 September). 'In 1963, the Federation was reconstituted as Malaysia'; infobox 'Malaysia Agreement: 16 September 1963'; it then federated with Singapore, Sarawak and North Borneo.

wars.name: Malayan Emergency
wars.outcome: 'Commonwealth victory'; 'On 31 July 1960 the Malayan government declared the state of emergency to be over'; the remaining MNLA 'fled to the Thai border'.
wars.note: Infobox '16 June 1948 - 31 July 1960' (the body says 17 June). The page records no territorial change: the guerrillas 'envisaged establishing control in "liberated areas"' but 'did not succeed in this', so there is no contest or occupation event and no zone; the Briggs Plan moved 'some one million rural civilians' into 'new villages' from 1950. The war began nine years before the state. Reviewer se-04-b (2026-10-20): 'from' set to 1957, the first year of this dossier's life; the war began on 16 June 1948 under the British-protected Federation (1948-1957), which this dossier does not draw. Fix fx-49: the war starts with the state's life in 1948 (infobox 16 June 1948 - 31 July 1960) now that the dossier begins on 1 February 1948.

certainty.note: The frontier is the Peninsula's coasts, the Johor Strait and the Thai boundary; no page opened gives a border dispute.

notes: Wikidata Q1479726 is shared with Cliopatria's 'Malaya' (1294-1351), which the malaya dossier shows is a different state (a catch-all for the Malay principalities); only the id is the same, so there is no merge. The Federation of Malaya existed from 1 February 1948 as a British protectorate (infobox 'Protected state of the United Kingdom (1948-1957)'); this dossier starts at the sovereign date of 31 August 1957 because Cliopatria keeps the land in its British Colonial Empire row to 1957 and starts the Federation in 1958; a gap-filler may prefer to start in 1948 with the British side recording a vassal_start for the protectorate. The Malayan Union (1946-1948, 'a single British crown colony') is not given a dossier. Malaysia is a separate Cliopatria row (Q833) and its own dossier; the federation was 'reconstituted as Malaysia' and could be read as the same state renamed. The Malayan Emergency (1948-1960) left no insurgent-held land on the page, so the additions batch has no rebel zone to add. Page budget (1-2) was spent on the Federation of Malaya and Malayan Emergency articles. Fix fx-49 (2 Nov 2026, request R142 of window p1940-p1949): the dossier now begins on 1 February 1948, the date the Federation page gives for its establishment as a 'protected state of the United Kingdom (1948-1957)', instead of the independence of 31 August 1957: new predecessor malayan-union, new keyframe federation-of-malaya_1948 (1948-1956, the 1958 shape), found on 1 February 1948 from malayan-union, a vassal_start/vassal_end pair with british-colonial-empire for 1948-1957 (the old 1957 found and gain are gone), the capital and the Emergency from 1948. The earlier note above that this dossier starts in 1957 is superseded. The p1940-p1949 patch's british-colonial-empire gain of February 1948 (events/12) is now redundant.
